The applicant is requesting a Zone District Map Amendment (Zone Change) from MUB Mixed-Use
Business Emphasis toPPublic fora 74,168square-foot site which contains the main office of the
Cheyenne Housing Authority.
ZONE CHANGE ANALYSIS
The subject property is located on the east side ofthe City just north of Dell Range Boulevard, a busy
commercial street.The site contains the main office building and accessory structures for the Cheyenne
Housing Authority.The Cheyenne Housing Authority provides decent, safe, sanitary and affordable
housingfor the elderly, disabled and the economically disadvantaged.
The subject property resides in and is surrounded by a MUB zone district. Other zone districts adjacent
to the subject property are a City zoned CB Community Business district to the south and a County
zoned MU Mixed Use zone districts to the north.

The site resides on the northwest corner of Sheridan Street and Ridge Road and contains a 10,500 square
foot office building, a garage, a parking lot and a fleet fueling station.

a. Intent. The P district is intended primarily for public sites, buildings and uses where activities conducted
provide service to the public, including educational facilities, recreational areas, and community service
facilities. The sites, buildings, and uses in this district may create important identifying features of the
neighborhoods and centers of the City, and should incorporate distinctive civic architecture and site design
that emphasizes Cheyenne's regional architectural identity through character, quality, and authenticity where
appropriate.
b.Applicability.TheP district is applicable to government buildings and uses in areas where it is necessary to
support adjacent or nearby development withpublic services or facilities, and specifically the Parks and Open
Space or Public and Quasi-public future land use categories in the Comprehensive Plan.
